key_insight: IteraSim RAG improves OpenFOAM case generation by using multi-query retrieval, deterministic routing, and a multi-agent generate/review loop instead of a single flat LLM agent.
engineering_relevance: This could make CFD setup more accessible for non-specialists while reducing configuration errors in solver, turbulence, and boundary-condition dictionaries.
method: LLM expands each request into physics, solver-keyword, and troubleshooting queries
Reciprocal Rank Fusion and MMR combine and diversify retrieval from an HNSW dense vector store
Architect, InputWriter, and Reviewer agents work with a canonical-knowledge layer to draft and repair cases
evidence_signal: On a 28-case benchmark, the system reached 77.9% mean retrieval coverage and all six reference configurations ran successfully on OpenFOAM v2506, with two corrupted cases repaired in the Reviewer loop.
watch_item: Performance depends on a curated canonical-knowledge layer and bounded repair loop, so robustness may drop for novel physics or cases outside the released benchmark.
paper_title: IteraSim RAG: A Multi-Stage Retrieval-Augmented Agentic Back-End for OpenFOAM-Based Computational Fluid Dynamics
